svg.text: EXP08 - the circular nub motion, recovered from the gain-1 capture
40 ms boxcar (nulls the 50/25 Hz mains) then mean removed, first 5 s (driver calibration) dropped
the motion is now clearly above the rest floor (sd 143k/156k vs 95k/96k) - but x and y move together, so it is a line, not a ring
circle capture - x(t) and y(t), mains-nulled (2739 samples, sd x 143094 / y 156151)
x-y scatter, same processing (green = circling, grey = rest)
